Name: AgusIV's Decorations
Author: AgusIV
Description:
[size=5][color=#cc4125]THIS IS AN ALTERNATE TEXTURES MOD[/color]
[/size][color=#cc4125]You will need to buy the tools needed to get access to some textures

[/color]This mod includes 16 different flooring and 32 different wall textures.
- 5 of those textures are from the game terraria,[b] credits to them
[/b]They can be accessed via using the vanilla catalogue.

It also includes the florian and emo set, which can be obtained using the Alternate Textures paint bucket bought at Robin's.

- Walnut Chair turns into Emo Chair
- Walnut Table turns into Emo Table
- Modern Lamp turns into Emo Lamp

- Stump Seat turns into Florian Chair
- Luau Table turns into Florian Table
- Classic Lamp turns into Florian Lamp

Manifest.Description: Adds unique furniture, walls and flooring.
